Spatial computing research · 2026

Honda Spatial Research

Exploring how physical products are reviewed in space.

Spatial computing research with USC Iovine and Young Academy and American Honda, exploring high-fidelity product visualization and industrial design review on Apple Vision Pro.

Role
Spatial Computing Researcher
Tools
visionOS, RealityKit, CloudXR, Omniverse
Team
USC Iovine and Young Academy × Honda Impact Lab
Platform
Apple Vision Pro

This project is under NDA. Selected project imagery and a high-level research overview are shared here.

Research at the intersection of physical and digital.

In collaboration with American Honda, the research explored real-time 3D streaming, interaction fidelity, multi-user design review, and annotation prototypes. My contribution combined spatial research with hands-on prototyping in the visionOS environment.

Further details available on request.
